<ParamField body="alwaysShowTooltip" type="boolean">
  Allows the tooltip even when the text is not truncated.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="isFocusable" type="boolean">
  Adds an optional tab stop. Native tabIndex and focusable render elements also open the tooltip on focus.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="isTooltipMultiline" type="boolean">
  Preserves whitespace and line breaks in the tooltip.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="lineClamp" type="number">
  Positive integer limiting visible lines, matching Text. Cannot be combined with `truncate`.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="render" type="ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | ComponentRenderFn&lt;HTMLProps, {}&gt;">
  Replaces the default div. Native props, styles, handlers and ref target the displayed text, not the popup.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="text" type="string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement&lt;unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor&lt;any&gt;&gt; | Iterable&lt;ReactNode&gt; | ReactPortal | Promise&lt;...&gt; | null | undefined" required>
  Caller-owned text or React content. Non-string content requires `tooltipContent`. URLs stay plain text.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="tooltipContent" type="string">
  Plain text displayed in the tooltip. Defaults to nonempty string `text`.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="tooltipDelay" type="number">
  Hover delay in milliseconds.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="tooltipPlace" type="&quot;bottom&quot; | &quot;left&quot; | &quot;right&quot; | &quot;top&quot;">
  Preferred side of the tooltip.
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="truncate" type="boolean">
  Single-line ellipsis by default. Set false to wrap. Cannot be combined with `lineClamp`.
</ParamField>
